Fixas: Recurring fixed monthly commitments with a predictable, roughly constant amount: rent, financing installments, insurance, subscriptions, phone/internet, recurring taxes.
Variáveis: Recurring essential spending whose amount changes month to month: groceries, fuel and daily transport, pharmacy and routine health, home utilities (power/water/gas), personal care.
Extras: Irregular, one-off or unexpected necessary expenses, usually larger: medical and hospital, car or home maintenance/repairs, moving, school supplies, legal.
Adicionais: Discretionary optional spending (wants, not needs): leisure and entertainment, travel, dining out and delivery, clothing, gifts, hobbies.
